title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Shared-Trip Schedule
content:
**Schedule.** The shared-trip schedule of the onsite visit amount of a ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket counts the agreement's resolved tickets of labor class onsite business-hours and labor route invoice in the last 6 months (a month window ending today, this visit included):

| Such visits in the window | Trip charge carried by the visit |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | no trip charge |
| 2 | 50 percent of the tier's onsite trip charge, rounded half up to the cent |
| a single visit | the tier's onsite trip charge |

A whole month between two dates is counted only once the later date reaches the same day of the month as the earlier one, and a month window of N months ending today takes the entries dated fewer than N whole months before today. Visits are counted by the moment of their resolution in the agreement's ticket history.

**Hypothetical figures.** With a trip charge taken as 100.00 for illustration: a single visit carries 100.00; a visit that is the second within the window carries 50.00; a visit that is the third or later carries nothing. With a trip charge of 100.05, the shared figure 50.025 rounds half up to 50.03.
